hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the one-parameter symbolic template F(t) = V(t)*G0(t)*V(t). Instantiate F by substituting t -> p to obtain V(p)*G0(p)*V(p), and t -> q to obtain V(q)*G0(q)*V(q). The original expression is the sum of two instances of this template.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are defined for the symbolic arguments p and q.
The multiplication is associative so V(t)*G0(t)*V(t) is the common structural form.
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical summands are syntactically identical up to a consistent renaming of the scalar argument from p to q, so they are evaluations of the same parameterized symbolic product V(t)G0(t)V(t).
